standard-dialogue.player: I was wondering if you could do something for me while I work to close the rift.

standard-dialogue.npc: What is it? The rift will open soon and we should all be preparing to close it.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has not asked to have the barrier locked:

steps.player: I was wondering if you could close the barrier so that other adventurers don't interfere with us closing the rift.

steps.npc: Why would you want to do that? Wouldn't more help be appreciated?

steps.player: I believe that we already have what it takes to close the rift and I wouldn't want any other adventurers getting in the way.

steps.npc: I'll close the barrier once the rift opens. If you change your mind before the rift opens I can revert this.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player asked to have the barrier locked:

steps.player: I've changed my mind, we should allow other adventurers to join us in closing the rift.

steps.npc: I'll no longer close the barrier once the rift opens.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player is on a themed world for Guardians of the Rift:

steps.npc: I'm not sure that would be a good idea right now.

steps.text: You cannot lock this minigame on a Guardians of the Rift themed world.

The cells here can be used to power up barriers and rift guardians!
Take uncharged cells with you to charge them at altars!
Don't forget that different cells produce different rift guardians!
Imbued essence can only be made at altars. Keep an eye out for the right altars to open!
